name: Claude Code
description: Brain on a Claude subscription: runs Claude Code headless with Piomio tools.
settings.tokenRef.title: Token (vault reference)
settings.tokenRef.description: The output of `claude setup-token`, stored in the vault. If empty, the CLI's own login is used.
settings.command.title: CLI command
settings.allowedTools.title: Claude Code built-in tools
settings.allowedTools.description: Empty: the default set (Bash, files, web, tasks, skills and Piomio tools). On a Mac the shell runs in the sandbox and files outside the agent's folder are asked for: only the web, tasks, skills and Piomio tools from this list apply there.
setup.token.title: Claude Code token
setup.token.hint: Only if Claude Code is not signed in on this server: run `claude setup-token` on any computer with your subscription and paste the token here.
